title: EP6 / THP oil-pressure catalog and reference captures
engine_family: EP6CDT 5FV THP 156 (RCZ / 308 CC) and MED17.4 cousins

confidence.d429_on_5fv_specifically: medium — same generation, not yet read on a 5FV
confidence.scale_bar: high — u16 * 0.00016 bar; 0xFFFF = 10.49 bar matches the FAP 10500 mbar rail

sources: https://www.208gti.fr/showthread.php?4044-Diagbox-telemetry (208 GTi THP: 6A8 22 D429 pressure, 22 D47D oil temp)
https://www.forum-peugeot.com/Forum/threads/pids-torque-pro.137818/ (VLud: D429 * 0.00016 bar, D4D6 * 0.25 C, D47D * 0.25 C, D41D * 0.2 mV)
https://www.forumpassionepeugeot.it/viewtopic.php?t=125022 (same PIDs named for 208 I, not 208 II Puretech)

dids.name: oil_pressure_bar
dids.notes: Measured oil pressure. Unsigned: 0xFFFF is the 5 V sensor rail (~10.49 bar), not real oil.

dids.name: oil_temp_estimated_c
dids.notes: Estimated oil temperature. May be absent if D47D exists.

dids.name: oil_pressure_sensor_mV
dids.notes: Sensor voltage. Bench: ~500 mV at 0 bar, ~2000 mV at 4 bar (5.0 V ref). Not on every calibration.

field_captures.unit_note: author reported absolute; gauge = abs - 1.0 bar

measured_baselines.note: Read on Steve's own known-good RCZs on 2026-08-14 with this harness, block C2 offset 7. These are the comparison the 308 CC is judged against; everything above is published or third-party.

rcz_2_cold_start.shape: Pressure is HIGH from the first reading (3.96 bar 6 s after start), peaks near 4.7 bar around 25 s while the oil is still cold and thick, then decays as it warms and settles flat at about 2.0 bar by 60 s.

measured_baselines.mirror_agreement: The offset-47 copy tracked the offset-7 value within +/-0.25 bar on every sample of both healthy cars, usually within 0.1. A car where those two separate is doing something these two do not.
